title: Insuring an EV Costs 42% More. Here's Why #shorts

scenes.text: Your EV could cost you almost a thousand dollars more a year. And it's not the electricity.
One big comparison site found full coverage averages about thirty-two hundred dollars a year for EVs, versus twenty-two hundred for gas cars. Forty-two percent more.
The reason is repairs. EV crash repairs average about seven hundred dollars more, and lean harder on pricey factory parts.
And a damaged battery pack can cost nine to twenty-one thousand dollars to replace.
But here's the twist. For twenty twenty-four and newer models, the gap drops to eighteen percent. In a few states, new EVs are even cheaper to insure.
